# Geometry Wars 2 PC Plus v0.6.10

A small polish release. This is an unofficial fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's makers or publishers, and **no game files are included**: you need your own Xbox Live Arcade package.

## What's new

- **Cleaner title lettering.** The launcher's line-drawn title now has bevelled M, W and V: straight sides with short notches instead of long sharp points, so they match the rest of the boxy letters and the glow no longer spikes at the tips.

Everything from v0.6.9 (the redesigned launcher) and v0.6.8 (online leaderboards) is unchanged.

## Installing

1. Download **GeometryWarsRetroEvolved2-v0.6.10-windows-x64.zip**, extract it anywhere you can write to, and run `geometry_wars_retro_evolved_2.exe`. Updating: extract over your current folder, or use the launcher's update.
2. On the **Play** page click **Install from package...** and pick your Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 package (Title ID `584108FF`, game version 0.0.1.2).
3. Press **PLAY**.

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a DirectX 12 graphics card and the latest Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (x64) are needed. The build is not digitally signed, so SmartScreen may warn: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
